offers_products.reason: Manufactures SR Series piston aircraft and the Vision Jet, its core offerings.

offers_services.reason: Also offers flight training (Cirrus Approach), maintenance, and aircraft management, but these are secondary to aircraft sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Personal aircraft bought by individual owner-pilots for personal aviation (SR22, Vision Jet).

sells_to_organizations.reason: Also sells to flight schools, charter and fleet operators, and businesses, though individuals dominate.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue comes from one-off aircraft sales; training and service are a smaller share.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discretionary luxury personal aircraft purchases are easily postponed in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Each aircraft is a very large, infrequent purchase; delivery is described as once-in-a-lifetime.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for manufactured aircraft, not staff time; training and service are secondary.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual owner-pilots and small businesses, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs composite aircraft manufacturing plants, the Knoxville Vision Center campus, and training and service facilities.

notes: Asset-heavy and organization-buyer answers are judgment calls. The website text does not describe fleet or charter customers.
